Preserve My Games helps people keep games and mods playable and documented. We build software, write guides, and publish open metadata that does not require an account.
Ivan (Sudo-Ivan) started the project and maintains most of the code and writing today.
Software for game and mod preservation: dumping helpers, verification tools, catalog utilities, and other programs we use in our own work. We publish source when we maintain the repository.
Guides for people learning preservation or looking for a tested process. They cover hardware, dumping, emulators, mods, and long-term storage.

This policy explains how Preserve My Games handles information when you visit preservemygames.org.
Preserve My Games operates preservemygames.org. This policy applies to this website only. It does not cover other sites we link to, which maintain their own policies.

When you request a page, our server receives technical data needed to deliver the site, including your IP address, browser user agent, the requested path, and the time of the request. We may keep short-lived server logs for operations and security. We do not use this data for advertising or to build marketing profiles.
We do not run analytics, advertising, social widgets, or third-party tracking on this site. We do not sell personal information.

Pages are designed to work without JavaScript. If you use the theme toggle, your browser stores a light or dark preference in local storage on your device. We do not set tracking cookies. If your browser sends a language cookie we recognize, we may use it only when redirecting from the site root to a locale path.
Some pages link to third-party services, such as Ko-fi on the donate page. Those providers operate under their own terms and privacy policies. We do not control what they collect.
If you email us, we receive your message and any details you include. We use that information only to read and reply. Questions about this policy can be sent to
